news.title: Tencent Open-Sources DFly2: Speculative Decoding That Reuses the Target’s Sparse KV Cache
news.dek:
Tencent open-sourced DFly2, a speculative decoding drafter for sparse-attention LLMs. Each draft layer reuses the target's KV cache and top-k indexer picks, adding no draft KV memory and lifting 64K serving throughput by up to 81%. 
 The post  Tencent Open-Sources DFly2: Speculat
news.aiSummary: Tencent has open-sourced DFly2, a speculative decoding drafter designed for sparse-attention large language models. The system reuses the target model's KV cache and top-k indexer picks, which eliminates the need for additional draft KV memory. This approach increases 64K serving throughput by up to 81%.
